Но внутри тихо обкатывался другой продукт - ИИ-дилер Sunny. Блэкджек, живая раздача, без человека за столом.

Тестировали на живых игроках BetHog. Прежде чем показать индустрии.

Теперь Sunny уходит в Sentient Studios вместе с командой. Дилер заговорит на 74 языках вместо пятнадцати.

BetHog не провалился как казино.

Ставка была не на игроков. Ставка была на дилера.

LINKEDIN POST:

The VIP host program built to protect your highest spenders can also become the exhibit that sinks you in court.

A gambler in New Zealand wagered roughly NZ$500 million in turnover over three years at SkyCity Auckland - 294 visits, some sessions running a full 24 hours straight - and lost NZ$33 million. He is now suing the casino, and the core of his claim is simple: he says he was treated as an "international VIP," and that status is exactly what let continuous-play harm checks get waived.

This isn't a story about one whale. It's a live stress test of every host discretion policy in the industry. The moment a VIP tier grants exceptions to responsible-gambling triggers - fewer cooling-off prompts, faster re-entry, relationship management standing in for system oversight - that exception becomes discoverable evidence.

The operators who come out fine here are the ones who never let VIP status override monitoring in the first place - continuous-play detection that applies identically whether the player is spending $500 or $500 million.

Perks should never buy a player out of the same duty-of-care checks everyone else gets.

#iGaming #VIPRetention #CasinoOperations #PlayerExperience
